top_sources.problem:
Investigation of Sporadic Service Interruptions Dear Customer Support Team,

I am writing to report a critical problem involving sporadic outages experienced across several products hosted on our cloud-based SaaS platform. The issue seems to be impacting system availability and performance, significantly disrupting our operations.

The root cause appears to be related to possible failures in Kubernetes orchestration errors within the CI/CD pipeline. During initial troubleshooting, we thoroughly reviewed service logs and identified irregularities that provide conclusive evidence for pinpointing the underlying problem.
top_sources.resolution: Thank you for providing detailed information about the intermittent outages. To assist you further, could you please share specific timestamps of the incidents, relevant Kubernetes event logs, and error messages observed during the downtime? Additionally, please confirm if any recent infrastructure or network modifications have been made. This information will help us identify the root cause and recommend suitable solutions. We appreciate your cooperation and prompt attention to this matter.
